title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Lisa Dicker is a Clinical Instructor in the Harvard Negotiation & Mediation Clinical Program (HNMCP). Prior to joining HNMCP, Lisa was Counsel at a global pro bono law firm where she advised on peace negotiations, conflict prevention, transitional justice, and post-conflict democratic transitions.
